fields.summary_ko.0: AMD (AMD) traded at $578.44 on October 28, with Citi and Aletheia Capital providing $800 price targets suggesting approximately 38% upside, while Wall Street's average target price is approximately $640 (11% upside).
fields.summary_ko.1: Citi expects the CPU market to grow from $29B in 2025 to $300B in 2030, with AMD benefiting from increasing demand for EPYC server processors and agent AI.
